title: Open Decisions
description: Every decision still Ingram's, generated from the open facts in canon/world/*.md by `node tools/story/story.mjs build` (D079: the plot timeline is the gold standard for story). Never edited by hand: a decision is answered on the timeline's Decisions view, which settles the fact in canon and removes it from here. Singleton file: data/campaign/open-decisions.json. It has the shape of open-questions.json so the Approvals Desk reads both the same way.
